name: The Fourth Birthday
summary: A four-year-old's birthday party at Coyote Point, and nothing to investigate. Yui Tanaka, the flight attendant who held {{pc:4}}'s bag at the gate and nearly lost her job over a moment she cannot remember, wants to meet the passengers who never blamed her. There is too much food, a real snake at the museum across the park, a cake with the wrong number on it, and a piñata. Four of the five get something small and their own. Then, for ninety seconds, a child stops breathing and makes no sound, and {{pc:2}} is there before she has decided to be.
hooks: Reggie, the gate agent from the night of the flight, texts {{pc:4}} an invitation on Yui's behalf.
Yui is still fighting the write-up, and nobody will show her what it says.
Nia Chen said yes to lunch weeks ago and has not named a day.
inGameDate: Saturday 13 March 2027, 1pm — three weeks after the morning at Rosa's
arcBeats: {{pc:2}} acts before she has decided to, and afterwards, in the quiet, something small happens that she was not trying to do.
{{pc:3}} reads an absence in someone else's ordinary life, pays for it with a headache, and meets a person who would rather it stayed cut.
{{pc:5}} finds a room where charm cannot explain what happens: the smallest guests keep choosing him.
{{pc:1}} fixes something a room has decided not to see.
Nia names the day of the next session.
